card.name: The digits 3 and 7 in numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 3 (sometimes 7 or 2) when it starts a number, mostly in dose amounts, volumes, or product specifications. It appears before a decimal point, a unit such as mg/kg, or a hyphen as in 3-way.
